target_path.description: Target directory or filename to create the torrent for.

output_filename.description: Path and filename of the created torrent file.

name.description: Name of the torrent. Default is the basename of the target.

piece_length.description: Set the piece length to 2^n bytes. Default is 18.

private.description: Set the private flag for the torrent.

announce_urls.description: Full announce URLs. Additional entries add backup trackers.

web_seed_urls.description: Web seed URLs. Additional entries add more URLs.

comment.description: Comment to add to the metainfo.

threads.description: Number of threads for calculating hashes. Default is number of CPU cores. Set to 0 to use default.
